title: Architecture and Core Concepts
text: metapip follows three core principles: GitHub source truth. PIP packages live PIP-Technical-Team GitHub organisation. metapip uses GitHub API (gh::gh(), httr2) discover branches, read commit metadata, download DESCRIPTION files – maintain registry. Lock-driven reproducibility. Deterministic installs achieved via PIP_LOCK.csv file pins every core package exact commit SHA. analogous renv.lock works CRAN packages. Resilient installation. Individual package failures isolated – one failed install abort rest. Functions always return sensible defaults error (e.g., NA data.frames NULL).

title: Architecture and Core Concepts
text: metapip uses two-tier branch resolution system: Global default (metapip.default_branch option, default "PROD"): Applies packages unless overridden. Per-package custom branches (metapip.custom_branch option): named list overrides global default specific packages. Example: list(pipapi_branch = "DEV", pipfaker_branch = "main"). Resolution order: Functions accept branch argument always check order: pass branch = "DEV" explicitly, options ignored.

text: fcase() / fifelse() come data.table, collapse. collapse export ; use data.table’s (import(data.table, except = fdroplevels) NAMESPACE). installed collapse 2.1.7 export fcase/fifelse — verify "fname" %% getNamespaceExports("collapse") relying collapse function. Prefer base ifelse (utils::compareVersion version comparison); metapip defines internal package_version() color formatter, always fully qualify base::package_version / utils::compareVersion. collapse::join(..., = "full") returns joined columns — never creates status column. Compute comparisons explicitly (e.g., utils::compareVersion via mapply; scalar, vectorized). GitHub timestamps (...Z) must parsed .POSIXct(x, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OSZ", tz = "UTC") — %OS handles optional fractional seconds; never rely host TZ. Prefer cli::cli_warn() cli::cli_alert_warning() test must expect_warning(). successful API responses (genuine 404 gh_errors) cached — never error fallbacks. GitHub API calls memoized per R session (session-scoped .metapip_cache); restart R invalidate, install_branch() invalidates per-package keys install.

title: Project Context
text: committed team lock manifest lives inst/PIP_LOCK.csv (package,branch,sha). pip_snapshot() writes/refreshes ; init_metapip() installs (falls back branch HEAD absent); update_pip_packages() refreshes . options(metapip.lock_path) overrides write target; pip_lock_path() (read-, via system.file) read path. system.file() returns "" file absent — never rely default write target without nzchar() guarding (write.csv(x, "") silently writes stdout Windows). Least-privilege tokens: read-GitHub functions work without PAT; install functions gate check_github_token(), returns redacted metapip_token (env-var first via gh_token(), gitcreds fallback). R testing: stop(msg, class = "foo") produce condition tryCatch handler named foo inherits — use rlang::abort(..., class=); validate installed rcmdcheck, just load_all(), since internal-symbol/condition semantics differ. mapply(compare_sha, ...) resists per-argument mockery mocks — keep mock return values single-valued per test block (see .cg-docs/solutions/testing-patterns/2026-08-13-tri-state-compare-sha-mockery.md).

title: metapip: Manage, Install, and Inspect PIP R Packages — metapip-package

Defaults `"PROD"`; set via [set_default_branch()]. - `metapip.custom_branch`: Named list per-package overrides   (e.g., `list(pipapi_branch = "DEV")`). Set via   [set_custom_branch()]. - `metapip.lock_path`: Custom path `PIP_LOCK.csv`. Defaults   bundled `inst/PIP_LOCK.csv`.

title: metapip: Manage, Install, and Inspect PIP R Packages — metapip-package
text: **Installation** - [install_branch()]: Install single package specific branch/SHA. - [install_pip_packages()]: Install multiple core packages branch. - [install_latest_branch()]: Developer-: install live branch HEADs. - [init_metapip()]: Lock-driven initialisation attachment. - [update_pip_packages()]: Refresh lock install outdated packages. **Inspection** - [get_branches()]: List available branches package. - [get_branch_info()]: Last commit metadata specific branches. - [get_latest_branch_update()]: recently updated branch. - [core_metadata()]: Overview core packages. - [package_branches()]: Version comparison across branches. **Lock management** - [pip_snapshot()]: Write `PIP_LOCK.csv` lock manifest. - [pip_lock_path()]: Path committed lockfile. **Branch configuration** - [get_default_branch()] / [set_default_branch()]: Global default branch. - [get_custom_branch()] / [set_custom_branch()]: Per-package branch   overrides. - [get_current_branches()]: View current branch assignments. - [get_package_current_branch()]: Branch single package. **Credential management** - [check_github_token()]: Validate GitHub credentials. **Utilities** - [metapip_packages()]: List metapip dependencies. - [metapip_update()]: Check CRAN updates. - [pkg_deps()]: List compare package dependencies. - [rowname_to_column()]: Move row names column.

title: metapip 0.1.0
text: get_core_packages() added correctly spelled alias deprecated get_core_pagkages() (spelling kept backward compatibility). package_branches() now reports accurate local_status column (behind/ahead/--date, plus “local”, “repo”, “unknown” unparseable versions). New pip_snapshot() writes committed team lock manifest (PIP_LOCK.csv package,branch,sha columns). init_metapip() now lock-driven: installs package recorded SHA falls back branch HEAD (pip_snapshot() suggestion) lock absent. update_pip_packages() refreshes lock installs outdated packages new SHAs. get_branches() now paginates branches (.limit = Inf), repos 30 branches fully returned. Least-privilege token handling: read-GitHub calls (get_branches, core_metadata, get_branch_info, get_latest_branch_update, package_branches) longer require PAT, print(check_github_token()) shows redacted token.

title: metapip 0.1.0
text: package_branches() longer fails runtime: join_and_get_status() previously referenced local_status column join never produced, malformed remote Version strings now degrade "unknown" instead crashing report. install_branch() now pins resolved branch HEAD SHA default (session-level determinism) idempotency short-circuit (force = TRUE bypasses pinning installs live HEAD; sha = overrides resolved SHA). get_latest_branch_update() handles empty gh-pages-branch sets, parses timestamps UTC. install_latest_branch() skips packages already HEAD branch now developer-(warns bypasses team lockfile). get_package_version() uses httr2 timeouts graceful error handling. update_pip_packages() isolates per-package failures reports summary (N succeeded, M failed); longer hangs non-interactive sessions. detach_package() warns continues unloadNamespace() failure. README codecov badge longer carries ?token= parameter.

title: metapip 0.1.0
text: Per-session memoization GitHub API calls get_branches(), latest_commit_for_branch(), core_metadata(). Repeated calls R session hit cache instead API (~80 calls reduced ~3 full core_metadata() refresh). successful responses cached transient failures retried. metapip_attach() rs_theme() use per-package requireNamespace() checks instead full installed.packages() library scan.

title: metapip 0.1.0
text: Full test coverage exported functions using mockery stubs; un-skipped production-path tests. Network-dependent tests gated skip_if_offline() + skip_on_cran(). Deleted obsolete test nonexistent install_all_packages().

title: metapip 0.1.0
text: Cleaned globalVariables() declarations (duplicates unused data.table symbols removed). Removed duplicate @docType package roxygen R/metapip.R. CI runs R CMD check Ubuntu Windows; GitHub Pages deploy uses actions/checkout@v4.
